subject: The Shadow Temple - Catacombs
text: Run back through the fake wall, go right, then left around the next corner, use the Lens of Truth to pass through the wall flanked by two pots, run down the passage through another fake wall, go right and left at the next corner, use the lens to see through the final wall, and go through the door into the Deadhand Room.

evidence.quote: Run back through the fake wall, and go right on the other side, then left around the next corner.  Use the Lens of Truth to see through the wall flanked by two pots, and go through it.  Run down the passage and through another fake wall.  Go right and then left at the next corner, and use the lens to see through the wall at the other end of the hall.  Go through the wall and through the door on the other side.

subject: Deadhand
text: Let one of Deadhand's hands grab you so his body appears, struggle free, wait for his head to lower, and execute a Jump Attack before he can strike.

evidence.quote: Remember, allow one of his hands to grab you, and Deadhand's body and head will appear and move slowly towards you.  Struggle free of the hand holding you by rotating the control stick and slamming buttons, then Z-Target Deadhand's head.  Stand still (out of the range of the hands), and wait for Deadhand to get near you, at which point his head will lower to attack.  Execute a Jump Attack before Deadhand can attack, and he will begin to run away, eventually sinking back into the ground.

subject: Deadhand
text: The Biggoron Sword can kill Deadhand in only a few hits, though Jump Attacks tend to fly right past him.

evidence.quote: The Biggoron Sword can kill him in only a few hits.  The only problem with the Biggoron's Sword is that Jump Attacks tend to fly right past the Deadhand.

subject: Chest
text: After defeating Deadhand, open the chest that appears to obtain the Hover Boots, which allow you to walk on thin air for limited periods.

evidence.quote: After the Deadhand dies, then a chest will appear in the room.  Open them to get the Hover Boots, which let you walk on thin air for limited periods of times.

subject: The Shadow Temple - The Raven Room
text: In the Raven Room, run forward through the fake wall to the cliff, equip Hover Boots, and run off the cliff to the tongue-shaped ledge on the other side.

evidence.quote: Run forward through the fake wall, and then to the cliff.  Equip the Hover Boots, and run out off the cliff to the ledge on the other side (it's carved in the shape of a tongue).

subject: Beamos
text: Kill the Beamos by throwing a bomb or two into its head.

evidence.quote: Kill the Beamos by hurling a Bomb or two into it's head, then go to the wall on the right.

subject: The Shadow Temple - The Raven Room
text: The wall on the right near the Beamos is fake, leading through a door to the Gibdos Room.

evidence.quote: then go to the wall on the right.  It's actually fake.  Run through it and through the door on the other side.

subject: Chest
text: Kill the pair of Gibdos in the Gibdos Room to make a chest appear containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Kill the pair of Gibdos in this room (if you missed them in the Bottom of the Well, Gibdos are more aggressive versions of Redeads).  A chest will appear upon their demise.  Open it to get the Compass.

subject: The Shadow Temple - The Raven Room
text: Run back through the fake wall, past the Beamos, and head through the fake wall to the north to reach the Scythe Room.

evidence.quote: Run forward back through the fake wall, and kill or dodge the Beamos.  Run north and through the wall north of the Beamos - it's another fake.

subject: Scythe
text: You can roll under the rotating Scythe blades if timed correctly.

evidence.quote: You can roll under the Scythe's blades if you time it correctly.

subject: Silver Rupees
text: Collect two Silver Rupees in the middle of the room in the Scythe's path, a third by Longshotting to the northwest target and jumping off the wood stack, a fourth in the west alcove, and a fifth in the northeast alcove.

evidence.quote: Run forward and grab the two Silver Rupees which lie in the middle of the room, directly in the Scythe's path...Now, run to the north wall, and use the Longshot to pull yourself up to the Longshot target in the northwest corner.  Jump off the stack of wood to grab another Silver Rupee...Go to the alcove in the west wall and grab another Silver Rupee, then go to the alcove in the northeast corner and grab another Silver Rupee.

subject: Chest
text: Collecting all the Silver Rupees opens the grating in the southeast corner, revealing a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: The grating in the southeast corner will open, revealing a chest.  Open it to get a Small Key, then return through the door you came through in the south of the room.

subject: The Shadow Temple - The Raven Room
text: Bomb the rough wall to the east in the Raven Room to destroy the barrier covering the passage to the Guillotine Chamber.

evidence.quote: Run back through the fake wall, the bomb the rough wall to the east.  The barrier covering the passage behind it will be destroyed.  Run down the passage and through the door on the other side.

subject: Big Skulltula
text: Eliminate the Big Skulltulas hanging from the ceiling along the ramp series using the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Run down the ramp in front of you, moving slowly to watch out for Big Skulltulas hanging from the ceiling.  Eliminate them with the Longshot.

subject: Guillotines
text: Run around each guillotine as it rises or roll under them to move quickly, watching for the Big Skulltula between the first and second blades.

evidence.quote: In front of you are a series of gigantic guillotines that drop down from the ceiling.  Run around each guillotine individually as they rise into the air.  Roll under them to move more quickly, if you're feeling nervous.  Watch out for the Big Skulltula which hangs between the first and second guillotines.

subject: Wall Master
text: Wait for the Wall Master to drop down and kill it completely until it burns on the ground, rather than knocking it off the cliff.

evidence.quote: Run around in a circle, waiting for the Wall Master to appear, and kill it when it drops down...Note that knocking the Wall Master off the cliff doesn't count.  You have to actually kill it and see it burn on the ground to work.

subject: Stalfos
text: After jumping past the three guillotines, hold up your shield on the small platform and attack only immediately after the Stalfos strikes.

evidence.quote: After the jump from the third guillotine, you will land on a small platform where you will have to combat a Stalfos...Remember to hold your shield up and only attack immediately after the Stalfos does.

subject: The Shadow Temple - Guillotine Chamber
object: The Shadow Temple - Invisible Scythe Room
text: After defeating the Stalfos, use the Lens of Truth to spot invisible platforms to the east and north, jumping across them to reach a door.

evidence.quote: Once the Stalfos is out of the way, look to the east with the Lens of Truth to see an invisible platform.  Jump out to it again, and jump once more to a platform in the corner.  Still with the Lens of Truth on, look north and jump along more invisible platforms until you reach a door.  Go through it.

subject: Lens of Truth
text: Rapidly turning the Lens of Truth on and off prevents it from consuming magic.

evidence.quote: Remember, if you rapidly turn the Lens on and off, it doesn't consume magic.

subject: Chests
text: Beyond the grating in the Invisible Scythe Room are two chests containing a Blue Rupee and Arrows, with the second chest visible using the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote: Go through it and kill the Gold Skulltula on the other side, as well as two chests which contain a Blue Rupee and Arrows (use the Lens to see the second chest).

subject: Platform with Blade Traps
text: From the rising and falling platform, jump to the narrow cliff halfway to its apex, head southwest to dodge the Blade Traps, collect four Silver Rupees, and bomb the Beamos to grab the fifth Silver Rupee.

evidence.quote: Jump out to this cliff when the rising/falling platform is about halfway to it's apex.  Run southwest along the cliff, where you will reach a wide platform which has a rotating set of Blade Traps and five Silver Rupees.  Grab four of the Silver Rupees by running around the platform, dodging the Blade Traps (there is a large gap between the pair that you can stand safely in).  The last Silver Rupee is underneath the Beamos.  Blow it up with bombs to reach it.

subject: Stone Block
text: Use the Lens of Truth to see the stone block embedded in the right wall, pull it out until it aligns with the smiling face on the floor, and push it forward to block both crushing spiked ceilings.

evidence.quote: Use the Lens of Truth and look to the right wall as you enter this room, and you'll see a stone block embedded in the wall.  Grab hold of the block and pull it out until it lines up with the smiling face carved into the floor.  Now, push the stone block forward until it prevents both of the crushing ceilings from falling.

subject: Gold Skulltula GS083
text: Move around the stone block into a cell opening to the south, kill the Gold Skulltula, and retrieve its token with the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Move around to the other side of the stone block, and look to the south where you will see an opening leading into one of the cells in the room.  Go inside and kill the Gold Skulltula, and take it's token with the Longshot.

subject: Chest
text: Pull the stone block back, climb onto it to reach the north ledge, bridge across the crushing ceiling to step on the south switch, then cross to the northeast ledge chest to get a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Step on the switch on the south ledge, and a chest will appear on a ledge in the northeast corner.  Hop onto the crushing ceiling just to the north of the switch, and jump from the there to the ledge with the chest.  Open it to find a Small Key.

subject: The Shadow Temple - Guillotine Chamber
object: The Shadow Temple - Silver Rupee Room
text: Head north along the narrow ledge, use the Lens of Truth to see the platform past the guillotine, jump as it rises, and jump across another horizontally moving platform to reach the door.

evidence.quote: Head north along the narrow ledge, where you will reach another timed jump involving a guillotine.  Use the Lens of Truth, and you will see the platform on the other side of the guillotine.  Wait for the guillotine to begin to rise, then jump to the platform.  Keeping the Lens of Truth on, look to the north to see another platform, this once moving to the left and right.  Jump out to it when it gets near enough, then jump to the ledge on the other side.  Go through the door.

subject: Chest
text: Kill both Redeads in the room to make a chest appear containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Start by killing both of the Redeads in the room, and then open the chest that appears.  Keep your Lens of Truth activated to avoid the invisible spikes around the room.  The chest contains a Blue Rupee.

subject: Door
text: Collect all five Silver Rupees across the room using the Lens of Truth and Longshot targets to unseal the door on the west side.

evidence.quote: Get the first Silver Rupee from the middle of the room, directly behind the set of invisible spikes closest to the door...Next pull yourself up to the Longshot target on the east side of the room, and you'll fall onto a Silver Rupee on your way down...Now go to the west side of the room, where there is another Longshot target, and a Silver Rupee suspended above the floor...If you look above the high ledge on the north wall with the Lens, then you'll see an invisible Longshot target on the ceiling.  You have to pull yourself up to this target, and pass through the Silver Rupee on the way to get it...The last Silver Rupee is on an invisible ledge in the northeast corner...Now that you have all five Silver Rupees, the door on the west side of the room will open.  Go through it.

subject: Skull
text: Kill the four Keese and toss a bomb into the hollow top of the large skull to explode it and reveal a Small Key in the rubble.

evidence.quote: When you get to the top, kill the four Keese (two of them are in the other corners of the room, but will attack you if they see you).  Once the Keese are out of the way, then toss a bomb into the hollowed-out top of the Skull.  The Skull will explode, revealing a key in the rubble.

subject: Gold Skulltula GS084
text: Kill the Gold Skulltula in the Skull Room to collect its token.

evidence.quote: Take the Key, and kill the Gold Skulltula for it's token, then return to the previous room.

subject: The Shadow Temple - Silver Rupee Room
text: Climb up to the platform on the north end of the Silver Rupee Room by using the Longshot on the invisible ceiling target, then proceed through the locked door.

evidence.quote: Climb up to the platform on the north end of the room by using the Longshot on the invisible target on the ceiling.  Go through the locked door.

subject: Gold Skulltula GS082
text: Kill the Gold Skulltula on the other side and take the Gold Skulltula Token.

evidence.quote: Go through it and kill the Gold Skulltula on the other side, as well as two chests which contain a Blue Rupee and Arrows (use the Lens to see the second chest).  Take the Gold Skulltula Token, then return to the Guillotine Chamber.
